text: {"lessons":["Taking profits in a stock feels rewarding, but selling winners in small pieces can leave me underexposed if prices keep rising.","A stock’s past gains or losses and my average cost do not predict its next move; I should make decisions based on future risk and return, not the desire to lock in gains or avoid realizing losses.","My account value fell over these periods despite several profitable sales, so I should assess the whole portfolio and maintain diversification rather than judging each stock as a separate account."]}
